gaps.sentence: He acted on his own ___ and did not ask permission.
gaps.hint: on your own ___ = without being told
gaps.explanation: 'On one's own initiative' = deciding and acting independently.

gaps.sentence: The venue was changed at ___ notice, just two days before.
gaps.explanation: 'At short notice' = only a short time before.

gaps.sentence: The negotiations broke down ___ the very brink of success.
gaps.explanation: 'on the brink of' = on the point of.

gaps.sentence: The phone rang ___ the middle of the ceremony.
gaps.explanation: 'In the middle of' = while something is happening.'

gaps.sentence: He denied everything ___ the face of the evidence.
gaps.hint: ___ the face of = when confronted with
gaps.explanation: 'in the face of' = despite / when confronted by.

gaps.sentence: The new policy was introduced ___ response to rising demand.
gaps.explanation: 'in response to' = as a reaction to.

gaps.sentence: Everything was packed ready in ___ of the movers' arrival.
The bus was so crowded that we travelled ___ discomfort.
